newsitem.title: UK: GATWICK HANDLING TO ACT FOR CLASSIC AIRWAYS.
newsitem.headline: GATWICK HANDLING TO ACT FOR CLASSIC AIRWAYS.

text.p: Gatwick Handling Ltd said it will act as ground handling agent for a new airline, Classic Airways at London-Gatwick, Stansted and Manchester.

The new airline has been set up in association with the Independent Aviation Group Ltd and is intended to provide a backup for the scheduled and charter flight market in the UK and Europe under the British World Airlines (BWA) air operating certificate, a statement said.
The airline will begin operations late this year with an ex-Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd Lockheed L-1011 TriStar now being refurbished and serviced by Marshalls of Cambridge.
This will offer 12 business and 330 economy seats and two additional aircraft are planned for next year, a statement said.

Routes will depend on customer requirements but are expected to include Mediterranean destinations with some cargo capacity available on each flight, industry sources added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
